2. After hearing the counsel for the petitioners for sometime, I am not inclined to quash the proceedings for the simple reason that the calendar case is registered in the year 2014 and the crime is also registered in the year 2014.
The petitioners can be allowed to file a discharge petition before the court below if charge is not framed and there can be a direction to consider the same within a time frame.
The presence of the petitioners can be dispensed with till final orders are passed in the discharge petition.

Therefore, this Criminal Miscellaneous Case is disposed of in the following manner:
1. The petitioners are free to file a discharge petition before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Tirur, within four weeks from the date of receipt of a stamped certified copy of this order, if charge is not framed.

sentences.text: 2. Once such a discharge petition is received, the Magistrate will consider the same and pass appropriate orders in it, after giving an opportunity of hearing to the petitioner and the Prosecutor concerned, within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of the discharge petition.
3. If a discharge petition is filed as directed above, the presence of the petitioner shall not be insisted by the Magistrate, till final orders are passed in the discharge petition.

4. If a discharge petition is filed as directed above, coercive steps against the petitioners shall also be kept in abeyance, till final orders are passed in the discharge petition.
5.
All the contentions raised by the petitioner in this criminal miscellaneous case are left open.
